newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemen to launch $80 million social development fund.
- Tunisia's airline Tunis Air plans to buy nine new aircraft in the next five years, the transport minister says.
- Gulf Air does not plan to move its headquarters from Manama to Abu Dhabi, its cheif executive says.
- Saudi British Bank investment in Saudi stocks soared to 14 billion riyals in the first nine months of 1996 from 10.7 billion riyals, its chairman says.
